children: SurgePays announced two agreements tied to a strategic asset disposition. The company sold its ClearLine engagement platform and GPOX Wireless assets to a GPO Plus subsidiary for $27.5 million in GPO Plus Series D Preferred Stock, convertible 1:1 into common shares and carrying no dividends, liquidation preferences, or voting rights. To secure value realization, SurgePays entered a Put Option Agreement with Emerald Shoals that allows it to sell the preferred or underlying common shares for $27.5 million during a three-year-and-90-day window starting at closing. As consideration for the put, GPO Plus will issue Emerald Shoals a five-year warrant for 15,000,000 common shares across three strike tranches.
